QuestInfo.name: Nero's Training 3
QuestInfo.0: Curse Eye hunting done! You're starting to feel pretty mighty. What else does #bNero#k have planned?
QuestInfo.1: Your third target is the #bCold Eye#k. Hunt down #b50#k and collect #b10 tails#k. These are more comfort food than snack.\r\n\r\n#bWhere the Sky Smiles#k is the closest place to go.
QuestInfo.2: You're done hunting Cold Eyes, and you're much stronger to show for it. Just make sure you reach #bLv. 30#k before returning to Three Moon.

default.0: Hunt 50 Cold Eyes and bring back 10 Cold Eye Tails!
